decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a niche defense application with long procurement cycles, so its uncertainty resolves slowly and keeping it costs little, which makes holding the option worthwhile despite thin website presence.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires have their own page, received a follow-on LED replacement kit, and serve a stable certified market, which signals that the option has already been exercised with further investment.
The relaunched designer task light builds on a proven popular design and is cheap to keep in the catalogue, so the evidence favors keeping it rather than abandoning it.

The pendant office luminaire is a recent launch whose prospects are still uncertain after pandemic-related disruption of office demand, so keeping this low-cost option open until demand recovers is sensible.

The premium pendant luminaire is still young, faces unresolved demand uncertainty, and adds little cost to a broad luminaire portfolio, so management keeps the option rather than dropping it prematurely.
